ci: every example's smoke test runs on Node 22.22.1 against openvibe-sdk/testing's mock platform (developer-app rules for Events, Media and Tools as in production) plus a local Chat WebSocket mock; none reaches the network
e2e: npm run e2e runs media-uploader, event-subscriber (pull) and tool-job against the real platform with a sandbox app's OV_CLIENT_ID/OV_CLIENT_SECRET/OV_PROJECT_ID; on demand only, not in CI or npm test; not run against production as part of this release
platform: sandbox developer path (projects, sandbox grants, app tokens for openvibe.media/events/tools, Media project tenant, Events app.<project_key>.* events, Tools jobs, CORS-open discovery) verified in production on 2026-09-23 by the platform's W20 exit check
not_working: no consent screen; no refresh tokens or identity for apps
/oauth/token is not CORS-open: browser apps exchange codes server-side
chat.message.send is first-party: the chat bot uses a Live hbt_ token
production apps and allowances need staff
plan: OpenVibe End-to-End Realignment & Implementation Plan, revision 3 (20 Sep 2026), §15.1, §18.9; roadmap Wave 20, §30, ADR-014
